**About Us \& Our Mission**
 For an enterprise B2B SaaS platform specializing in supply chain analytics and fintech settlement, onboarding a new corporate client isn't just about handing over a login—it often involves seamlessly integrating our platform with their legacy ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), warehouse management software (WMS), and core banking APIs.
   

  

 Our engineering culture values robust interface design, bulletproof error handling, and extensible integration architectures. If you love building universal adapters, webhook engines, and enterprise\-grade API gateways that bridge disparate software ecosystems, you will find your professional home here.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled
 **Enterprise Integrations \& API Engineer** 
 to take complete ownership of our client onboarding integration pipelines and B2B API gateway. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain secure integration connectors that ingest data from diverse external enterprise systems into our core platform. You will act as the technical bridge between our product infrastructure and our enterprise clients' complex technical environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Connector Development: Design and build robust ETL connectors, middleware adapters, and API wrappers for major enterprise systems (SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, WMS platforms).
* Webhook \& Event Engine: Architect and scale our reliable webhook delivery system, ensuring guaranteed at\-least\-once delivery, automatic retries, and rate limiting for external clients.
* API Gateway Management: Manage API versioning, authentication protocols (OAuth2, mTLS, API keys), request validation, and developer portal documentation.
* Data Transformation: Write flexible data mapping and transformation logic (using Python/Node.js and JSON/XML/EDI formats) to normalize disparate external data schemas into our internal data models.
* Troubleshooting \& Support: Collaborate with customer success and client engineering teams to diagnose integration blockers, payload mismatches, and authentication errors during client onboarding.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional backend software engineering experience focusing heavily on API design, integration engineering, or enterprise middleware development.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Python (FastAPI/Django) or Node.js, advanced RESTful API design principles, GraphQL, and asynchronous programming.
* Protocol Knowledge: Hands\-on experience with standard enterprise data exchange formats (JSON, XML, EDI X12, CSV) and secure communication protocols (OAuth2, Webhooks, mTLS).
* Database \& Tooling: Strong SQL skills, experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ/Kafka), and familiarity with API gateway tools or Kong/Apigee.
* Communication Skills: Excellent client\-facing technical communication skills and the ability to translate complex integration requirements into clean code.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-standard salary package (16–28 LPA) backed by performance bonuses and equity participation.
* High\-Visibility Role: Direct impact on enterprise client onboarding velocity and platform revenue growth.

* A process that needs straightforward automation

* Vector databases and vector storage

* Context management, evaluation and hallucination control

* What problem you were solving
* How you approached it
* What tools you used
* Which parts you built yourself
* Where AI helped you
* What you would improve if you built it again

title: Platform Engineer - OpenStack
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cloudstrats is an Indian exponential technology product company that builds Artificial Intelligence platforms powered by analytics and automation. Its solutions use computer vision, speech, and text technologies to address complex real\-world challenges for government and enterprise customers. The company’s platforms apply Deep Learning, NLP, and ML to support sustainable development goals across sectors such as citizen services, public safety, education, health, and transport. Cloudstrats delivers marquee projects including command control centers, e\-governance solutions, grievance redressal platforms, data hubs, fraud detection, and health systems. The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation
* Configure centralised logging, audit collection, and alert escalation



 Resilience, Backup \& Recovery
 


* Define and execute resilience tests (compute/controller/storage/network/Kubernetes/GPU/identity failure scenarios)
* Validate backup/restore against agreed RTO/RPO targets
* Produce test plans, execution evidence, and resilience reports



 Restricted\-Network Delivery
 


* Build and maintain internal package repositories and private container registries
* Prepare an offline bill of materials (packages, images, charts, drivers, firmware, licenses)
* Establish controlled import, scanning, signing, and promotion procedures
* Ensure deployment, patching, and recovery can operate without dependency on public internet access



 Lifecycle Ownership
 *(post go\-live)* 



* Own technical evolution: capacity expansion, tuning, upgrades, automation
* Act as escalation point for platform issues; lead root\-cause analysis
* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, and runbooks
* Train the internal cloud engineering team to independent competency



  





**Experience we Need.** 




  





 Core
 


* 6\+ years infrastructure/platform\-engineering experience; 3\+ years hands\-on OpenStack
* Demonstrable delivery of at least one production OpenStack environment from install through acceptance
* Evidence of personal technical contribution, not just project oversight



  





 OpenStack \& Kolla Ansible
 


* Strong working knowledge of Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Hands\-on Kolla Ansible: inventory, globals config, secrets handling, bootstrap, prechecks, deployment, validation, upgrades
* Ability to troubleshoot containerised OpenStack services and deployment failures



  





 Storage
 


* Hands\-on experience with a distributed SDS platform (Ceph preferred)
* Experience integrating storage with Glance/Cinder/Nova and Kubernetes CSI



  





 Linux, Compute \& Networking
 


* Deep Linux systems engineering (kernel, drivers, systemd, networking, storage stacks)
* Strong KVM/QEMU understanding
* VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, DNS, NTP, load balancing



  





 Kubernetes \& AI Platforms
 


* Production Kubernetes deployment and operation experience
* GPU scheduling via vendor device plugins
* AI/ML platform deployment (notebooks, training, model serving) strongly preferred



  





 GPU Virtualisation
 


* PCI/IOMMU passthrough, device binding, driver installation and validation in VMs/containers



  





 Identity, Observability \& Automation
 


* Enterprise directory integration, SSO/RBAC, certificate and secrets management
* Strong Python/shell scripting and Ansible or equivalent IaC experience



  





 Restricted\-Network Environments
 


* Demonstrable experience delivering in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments
* Comfortable with formal change control, security review, and audit evidence



  





**Desirable.** 



* Ceph RBD, CephFS, RADOS Gateway
* Octavia, Barbican, Ironic, Heat, Swift, Manila
* Kubeflow, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray, KServe, vLLM, or comparable AI/ML platforms
* NVIDIA GPU operators or equivalent vendor tooling
* Multi\-site disaster recovery experience
* CKA / CKS / Linux / OpenStack certifications (supplementary to delivery evidence, not a substitute



  





**You will own.** 




 High\-level and low\-level architecture · Capacity\-sizing workbook · Kolla Ansible configuration · IP/VLAN/DNS/firewall matrix · Storage architecture and recovery procedures · GPU enablement report · Kubernetes and AI\-platform architecture · Restricted\-network BOM · Security baseline · Monitoring/logging catalogue · Backup/RTO/RPO design · Migration and cutover plan · Resilience test plan and evidence · As\-built documentation · Runbooks and SOPs · Training materials

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world\-class strategic decision\-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 ClearView is looking for a Salesforce Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role covers Platform Configuration/Development, System Administration/Integration/Support, and User Enablement and Adoption. The primary focus will be hands\-on platform development and administration/integration, with user enablement and adoption as a supporting responsibility. This position requires the ability to work with minimal direction, adapt to changing demands, and identify opportunities for process improvement. This position will work in our India office but will be responsible for ClearView’s Salesforce platform globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Platform Configuration and Development**
* ClearView has locations in Massachusetts, New York, California, United Kingdom, Switzerland and India. This position will be responsible for configuring and maintaining ClearView’s Salesforce org to support business processes across all locations, including declarative configuration of objects, fields, page layouts, flows, validation rules, permission sets and reports.
* Build new functionality where it does not exist today to support business development, project delivery, expert network, and finance workflows.
* Develop and maintain custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and the Salesforce APIs where declarative tools are insufficient.
* Apply Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, governor\-limit\-aware design, automated testing, error handling and logging, asynchronous processing, code reviews, and source control.
* Maintain release management and change control practices across sandbox and production environments, including testing, deployment and documentation of changes.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, implement Salesforce changes within established standards, and document them for ongoing support.
* Annual review of org configuration, technical debt, and license utilization, with recommendations for enhancement.


**User Enablement and Adoption**
* Partner with business stakeholders and ClearView’s training group to support Salesforce adoption and effective use of the platform.
* Support adoption through clear communication, demonstrations, documentation, and targeted enablement as new capabilities are introduced.
* Develop reference materials, release notes, and office hours to support onboarding, ongoing platform use, and new feature rollouts.
* Work with the Salesforce Architect to share Salesforce knowledge and provide targeted enablement for the Information Technology Team.


**System Administration/Integration/Support**
* Work closely with other IT Infrastructure and Applications personnel to ensure Salesforce and connected systems are securely designed, deployed, and managed. This includes SSO/SAML, organization\-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy and sharing rules, permission sets, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Apex security considerations, data access models, and integrations with systems currently in place at ClearView.
* Provide recommendations on changes/enhancements to the above systems to ensure ClearView is using best in class platform capabilities.
* Evaluate and refine existing integrations, data quality, and platform performance/availability.
* Manage Salesforce data lifecycle considerations, including data retention, archiving/purge, data quality, bulk data operations, and how client data is stored or retained in downstream systems and integrations.
* Serve as Salesforce subject matter expert and key technical resource for the platform and connected tools, including data management, reporting/analytics, user provisioning, and AppExchange applications.
* Identify defects and performance issues through testing, monitoring and user feedback, and work with responsible teams to address and resolve them.
* Ensure compliance with ClearView’s IT and data protection policies and follow established change management procedures.
* In the event of system outages or data issues, work directly with the Salesforce Architect to diagnose the issue, manage the remediation process, and document the results.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Provide technical Salesforce expertise, support platform initiatives, and contribute to the Salesforce roadmap.
* Design and implement standardized deployment and testing checklists for all new Salesforce releases and connected applications.
* Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases and new platform capabilities and recommend appropriate action.
* Work with the Head of Information Technology to support audit processes related to system access and data integrity.
* As per client MSAs, ensure client data held in Salesforce is protected and ultimately purged as required.
* Perform other related duties and activities as required.


**Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a technical or computer science related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 4\-7 years of relevant Salesforce configuration and development experience.
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification or equivalent demonstrated real\-world Salesforce development experience.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to business and non\-technical stakeholders and support adoption through documentation, demonstrations, and training.
* Demonstrates strong problem solving, analytical, interpersonal, and ownership skills.
* Possesses excellent collaboration skills for work with various internal team members.


**Required Skills/Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs, sandbox management, and data loading tools.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, automation design, governor limits, platform scalability, and security, including OWD, sharing rules, permission sets, CRUD/FLS, SSO/SAML, and Apex security considerations.
* Experience applying Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, automated testing, error handling/logging, asynchronous processing, code reviews, source control, and maintainable implementations.
* Experience building and supporting Salesforce integrations using established patterns and APIs, including downstream data lifecycle and retention considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, release management, testing, source control, and deployments across sandbox and production environments.
* Experience with Salesforce data management, including data quality, bulk data operations, retention and archiving/purge, plus Salesforce Sales Cloud and advanced reporting/dashboard development.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Marketing Cloud.
* Experience with middleware or integration tools such as MuleSoft, Zapier, or Power Automate.


**What We Value**
 We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration.
